data.lastMessage:
Before I plan PROJ-3762 I need one decision: should articles be localized in this ticket?

The CMS i18n plugin is on, but Article has no locale field yet. Localizing now adds a locale field, a migration of the existing articles and the en routes in services/web; leaving it out keeps this ticket to the types, the listing and the article page.

- Localize fi + en now: one more stream and about a day more.
- fi only, localize later: Article stays fi only and I file a follow-up issue for the English site launch.

Recommendation: fi only, localize later. The English site has no launch date yet.

data.text: Write the release notes for PROJ-3762: every changed file, why it changed and how it was checked.

data.lastMessage:
## Release notes: PROJ-3762 offers and articles

PR #418 merged into dev, went to qa with #420 and to main with #426 together with #421. Four streams ran: api first, then web and ui after it, and email added during the build. Three reviewers looked at the diff; the code reviewer asked for one fix, which an implementer made and the re-review approved.

## Changed files

### 1. `services/api/src/api/offer/content-types/offer/schema.json` (stream api)

What changed: New Offer content type: title, slug, price in cents, valid from and to, hero image and a many-to-one relation to Dealer.

Why: The listing and the email need one typed source for offers instead of the free-text promotion field on Dealer.

How it was checked: Schema review approved; the api typecheck, lint and tests passed in one round.

### 2. `services/api/src/api/article/content-types/article/schema.json` (stream api)

What changed: New Article content type: title, slug, lead, rich-text body, cover image and an optional relation to Offer.

Why: Articles explain an offer in depth and the offer email links to them.

How it was checked: fi only as decided at Plan; a follow-up issue tracks the fi + en localization.

### 3. `services/api/types/generated/contentTypes.d.ts` (stream api)

What changed: Regenerated content types for Offer and Article.

Why: web and ui import these types, so they are committed with the schema change.

How it was checked: The generator ran clean and the diff only adds the two new types.

### 4. `services/api/src/api/offer/routes/offer.ts` (stream api)

What changed: Read-only public routes for offers with the default populate on dealer name and city.

Why: The listing shows the dealer next to each offer without a second request.

How it was checked: Covered by the api tests for the find and findOne routes.

### 5. `services/web/src/app/[locale]/offers/page.tsx` (stream web)

What changed: New offers listing page, statically rendered with a revalidation window of ten minutes.

Why: Offers change a few times a day; a static page with revalidation keeps the listing fast.

How it was checked: web typecheck, lint and tests passed in the second round after a missing import in the first.

### 6. `services/web/src/app/[locale]/articles/[slug]/page.tsx` (stream web)

What changed: New article page that renders the rich-text body and links back to its offer.

Why: Each article has a stable address that the offer email can link to.

How it was checked: Snapshot tests for an article with and without an offer.

### 7. `services/web/src/lib/offers.ts` (stream web)

What changed: fetchOffers and fetchOffer, with populate on dealer added in the Fix.

Why: The code reviewer found the listing rendered without the dealer name; the fix adds the populate and a test.

How it was checked: Re-review approved in round 2.

### 8. `libs/ui/src/OfferCard/OfferCard.tsx` (stream ui)

What changed: New OfferCard component: image, title, price, validity and dealer.

Why: web and the email preview share one card instead of two copies.

How it was checked: Stories for the default, expired and no-image states; the ui tests passed.

### 9. `libs/ui/src/OfferCard/OfferCard.module.css` (stream ui)

What changed: Card layout on the spacing and radius tokens.

Why: Keeps the card in line with DealerCard after the PROJ-3741 spacing fix.

How it was checked: Visual check in the stories at 375px, 768px and 1280px.

### 10. `libs/ui/src/ArticleTeaser/ArticleTeaser.tsx` (stream ui)

What changed: New ArticleTeaser component for the article lists and the offer page.

Why: The offer page shows a teaser of its related article.

How it was checked: Stories and a unit test for a missing cover image.

### 11. `libs/email/src/templates/offer.tsx` (stream email)

What changed: The offer email links to the article page when the offer has a related article.

Why: Readers asked for more detail than the email can hold.

How it was checked: The email preview renders both variants; the email tests passed.

## Decisions

- Articles are fi only in this ticket; the answer at Plan was "fi only, localize later", and the locale field waits for the English site.
- api ran first because web and ui import the generated content types; web and ui forked after it and ran in parallel.
- The offer email link was added mid-build as its own stream on haiku, since it touches one template and nothing else.
- The listing is static with a ten-minute revalidation instead of rendered per request; offers change a few times a day.
- Dealer name and city are populated by default on the public offer routes, so the listing needs no second request.

## Review

The conventions checker found nothing to change: English identifiers, one-line declarations, no hard-coded names.

The CMS reviewer approved the schema, the permissions and the populate rules, and asked one non-blocking question: should articles be indexed in the site search on publish? It expired unanswered when the PR merged and is kept as an improve follow-up.

The code reviewer asked for one change: the offers query had no populate on dealer, so the listing rendered without the dealer name. An implementer added the populate for name and city with a test, and the re-review approved it in round 2 with one issue follow-up on the empty image alt text.

## Follow-ups

- Localize Article (fi + en) before the English site launch (issue, from the api implementer).
- Index articles in the search engine on publish so site search covers them (improve, from the CMS reviewer).
- OfferCard image alt is empty; map the alternative text from the CMS media (issue, from the code re-review).
- Extract a CardShell into libs/ui: DealerCard and OfferCard repeat the same spacing (improve, from PROJ-3741).

## Verification

- api: `services/api/src/api/offer/content-types/offer/schema.json` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- api: `services/api/src/api/article/content-types/article/schema.json` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- api: `services/api/types/generated/contentTypes.d.ts` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- api: `services/api/src/api/offer/routes/offer.ts` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- web: `services/web/src/app/[locale]/offers/page.tsx` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- web: `services/web/src/app/[locale]/articles/[slug]/page.tsx` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- web: `services/web/src/lib/offers.ts` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- ui: `libs/ui/src/OfferCard/OfferCard.tsx` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- ui: `libs/ui/src/OfferCard/OfferCard.module.css` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- ui: `libs/ui/src/ArticleTeaser/ArticleTeaser.tsx` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.
- email: `libs/email/src/templates/offer.tsx` typechecked, linted and tested in its stream before Join; the joined diff was reviewed as one patch.

The wiki pages for Offers and Articles were updated as drafts by the doc-updater and published after the docs gate.

## Rollout

dev got the change with #418 and qa with #420 the same morning; main followed with #426, which also carried the dealer card spacing fix of #421. No migration ran on qa or main: both content types are new and start empty.
